# Install and Override shadcn/ui Base Components

Instalar os componentes primitivos do shadcn/ui via CLI e sobrescrever seus estilos padrão com os tokens de `design.json` mapeados no Tailwind.

## Local Context

**Files to create (generated by CLI):**
- `frontend/components/ui/button.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/input.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/card.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/badge.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/label.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/skeleton.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/tooltip.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/alert.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/table.tsx`
- `frontend/components/ui/separator.tsx`

**Command to run (inside `frontend/`):**
```
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add button input card badge label skeleton tooltip alert table separator
```

**Local dependencies:** Tailwind tokens from task-002 (`bg-primary`, `h-btn`, `rounded-btn`, `h-input`, `rounded-input`, `border-inputBorder`).

## Scope

1. Run the shadcn CLI add command above to generate all 10 component files.
2. Override `button.tsx` variants: primary variant uses `bg-primary text-white h-btn rounded-btn font-medium hover:bg-primaryHover transition-all duration-150 hover:scale-[1.01]`.
3. Override `input.tsx`: base class uses `h-input rounded-input border border-inputBorder bg-inputBackground focus:border-primary focus:ring-0`.
4. Override `card.tsx`: use `bg-surface border border-border rounded-card shadow-sm`.
5. Override `badge.tsx`: remove default color variants; accept `className` for color overrides (StatusBadge in task-013 will provide colors).
6. Keep `label.tsx`, `skeleton.tsx`, `tooltip.tsx`, `alert.tsx`, `table.tsx`, `separator.tsx` at their generated defaults — they will be styled by consuming components.

## Acceptance Criteria and Tests

- Success: All 10 files exist in `frontend/components/ui/`.
- Success: `pnpm build` passes without TypeScript errors.
- Success: A `<Button>` with no variant renders with dark green background and `52px` height in the browser.
- Success: An `<Input>` renders with `48px` height and `#DADDE2` border.
- Success: A `<Card>` renders with `16px` border radius and `1px solid #E5E7EB` border.
- Failure: Any shadcn default blue/slate color visible on Button or Input → override not applied correctly.
- Tests: Manual browser render check; render all components on a test page.

## Constraints and Negative Instructions

- Do NOT remove the `cn()` utility or `class-variance-authority` — shadcn depends on them.
- Do NOT add custom props beyond what shadcn provides; consuming components add context.
- Do NOT use inline styles to set colors; use Tailwind classes only.
- Do NOT modify files outside `frontend/components/ui/`.
